summary: Picker/Packer/Dispatch feature — full backend + frontend verification. Backend pytest 10/10 passing (queue, detail, scan-by-product_id, invalid scan 404, already_complete 409, set-item cap/floor, incomplete_picks 409, complete→ready, packer RBAC via staff-login, unauth 401). Frontend E2E on /partner-portal/picker verified: portal-nav-picker sidebar item, queue lists 8 accepted+packing orders with progress bars, clicking queue item routes to /partner-portal/picker/<id>, scan input auto-focused, invalid 'BOGUS123' scan renders red-flash friendly error 'BOGUS123 is not part of this order', per-line +/- buttons manipulate picked_qty and picker-line-qty-<id> updates X/Y live, picker-progress-pct updates 25%→50%→100% as items are picked, sticky picker-complete-btn disabled at partial + enabled at 100%, clicking Complete shows success toast 'DEMO-00005 marked ready for handoff' and navigates back to queue. Auto-flip accepted→packing after first scan/pick visible in queue (DEMO-00010 shows PACKING with 3/4 progress bar). Classic /api/partner/orders listing and status transition endpoints still work — not broken by this change.
critical_code_review_comments: picker_routes.py L61-69 — _load_order_or_404 explicitly skips per-store scoping ('for MVP we skip strict enforcement'). A packer at store A could theoretically call /orders/{po_of_store_B}/scan if they knew the po_id — queue only lists their own store but detail/scan endpoints don't re-check. Consider enforcing store_id via warehouse->partner_order linkage before v1.

picker_routes.py L266 — SKU/EAN matching does one session.get(MartProduct) per unmatched item inside the loop. For orders with >30 lines this is 30 sequential round trips. Batch load via select(MartProduct).where(MartProduct.id.in_(product_ids)) once, then match in-memory.

picker_routes.py L295-296 — after commit + refresh(pick), the picks dict still references the pre-refresh object, then reassigns picks[matched.id] = pick. Works but the intermediate picks dict for other lines is now stale relative to DB state. Not a bug today because we only read them via _pick_dict which reads .picked_qty from ORM objects; but a subtle correctness gotcha if _pick_dict grows to reference lazy relations.

picker_routes.py L127-143 — _ensure_picks creates pick rows on GET /orders/{id} without any lock; two concurrent GETs on the same order could race and both try to INSERT the same (partner_order_id, order_item_id) pair. Add a UNIQUE constraint on that pair in migration 0020 (verify present) and catch IntegrityError, OR use insert().on_conflict_do_nothing().

PickerPage.jsx — scan input auto-focus is confirmed on initial mount, but after clicking a +/- button the focus moves to the button and does NOT return to the scan input. USB barcode guns will then send keystrokes to nowhere. Consider re-focusing the input after any button click.
